# Day 25: Continental colour rendering sandbox integration + unused imports removed + redundant functions collapsed

🔧 Technical Wins:
• Decomposed working sandbox code for correct continental colour rendering (rasters solved continent colour bleed) into existing 
  tectonics.py and ui.py modules.
• Removed unused imports like cfeatures, scipy.spatial, pykdtree, importlib, numpy
• Removed redundancy; 
  - landmask_features and coastlines_features previously calling the same filepath, now collapsed into cob_features
  - reconstructing continental polygons in rasterise_landmask() now calls reconstruct_polygons() instead of repeating logic
  - reconstruct_coastlines now calls reconstruct_features using cob_features as argument
• Continent colouring works!

🪛 Next:
- Add caching of reconstructed polygons so they do not need recalculating at each time step.
- Disentangle the time step from the slider widget in the UI into a function render_time(), so that a panel of interactive 
  dino icons can call it and reconstruct tectonic-fossil movement to that time
